scripts.ugc:check: bun run ugc:typecheck && bun run ugc:test
scripts.web-access:boundary:check: bun -e "const root=JSON.parse(await Bun.file('package.json').text()); const web=JSON.parse(await Bun.file('packages/web-access/package.json').text()); if (!root.packageBoundaryNotes?.['web-access']) throw new Error('missing root web-access boundary note'); if (web.pi?.extensions?.[0] !== './src/index.ts') throw new Error('web-access extension seam moved'); if (!web.packageBoundary?.splitPolicy?.includes('No-move')) throw new Error('missing no-move split policy')" && pi -e ./packages/web-access/src/index.ts --help
scripts.open-design:run: OD_DATA_DIR="$PWD/data/open-design/default" PATH="$(mise where node@24)/bin:$PATH" pnpm --dir vendor/nexu-io--open-design tools-dev run --namespace agents-local

packageBoundaryNotes.web-access: Root Pi intentionally loads packages/web-access/src/index.ts while T-2026-06-09-005 splits registrations into focused packages; no-move cleanup slices should clarify manifests/docs without relocating files.
